_comment: SCRUM-1672 sanctioned-copy allowlist for `npm run lint:copy` (scripts/check-copy-terms.ts). Records PERMANENT §1.3 policy carve-outs — NOT tech debt (that is copy-terms-baseline.json, which the linter nags you to pay down). Matched on normalised (file, term) with NO line number, so it is immune to src/lib/copy.ts line drift. Fail-closed: an entry may ONLY name a term in ALLOWLISTABLE_TERMS (currently just 'issue credential'); loadAllowlist() drops any entry naming a secret / launch-blocker / other term, so this file can never silence a service_role/postgrest/worker-service/legal-placeholder leak. See scripts/agents.md → 'Copy-term sanctioned allowlist'.
_protocol: ADD an entry ONLY for copy that §1.3 itself sanctions (today: the SCRUM-1672 'Issue Credential' restricted verified-organization issuance action, allowed only in src/lib/copy.ts).
NEVER add an entry to silence a term you simply have not fixed — that is what copy-terms-baseline.json is for, and even there secrets/launch-blockers are non-suppressible.
Every entry needs a non-empty `reason` naming the sanctioning ticket. Entries are (file, term)-keyed; a DIFFERENT banned term on a sanctioned line is still reported fresh.
To sanction a NEW term you must first add it to ALLOWLISTABLE_TERMS in check-copy-terms.ts (a reviewed code change), then add the entry here.
